metrics.label: Peak absorbance A10
metrics.help: Decadic absorbance A10 = −log₁₀(T) = τ / ln(10), dimensionless. Uniform Beer-Lambert intensity attenuation.

metrics.label: Peak optical depth tau
metrics.help: Optical depth τ = −ln(T) = α_eff L, dimensionless. Uniform Beer-Lambert intensity attenuation.

metrics.label: Gaussian Doppler FWHM
metrics.help: Calculated thermal Gaussian FWHM for one optical line, from the cell temperature. It is not a measured Voigt or multi-line envelope FWHM.

metrics.label: Peak phase shift
metrics.help: Largest single-pass |φ| = k·(n−1)·L from the dispersive (real) part of the same susceptibility that gives the absorption, with n = 1 + Re χ/2. A phase quantity — not a group delay. It is the medium's phase alone: a deeply absorbed spectral region can carry a large phase with almost no light left to measure it.

metrics.label: SAS resolution
metrics.help: Fewer than six sample intervals span the interpolated feature FWHM.

metrics.label: Sub-Doppler FWHM
metrics.help: Interpolated residual half-height width near -1296.9 MHz; report the linewidth only when the SAS resolution status is resolved.

metrics.label: Half-height edges
metrics.help: Linear interpolation between the samples bracketing each half-height crossing.

metrics.label: Samples / FWHM
metrics.help: Interpolated FWHM divided by the local median sample spacing; at least 6 is required for resolved status.

metrics.label: Scan-edge distance
metrics.help: Nearest distance from either interpolated half-height edge to the displayed scan boundary; at least one FWHM is required.

metrics.label: Effective peak absorbance A10
metrics.help: Decadic absorbance A10 = −log₁₀(T) = τ / ln(10), dimensionless. Collected Gaussian power transmission; alpha_eff = -ln(T) / L.

metrics.label: Effective peak optical depth tau
metrics.help: Optical depth τ = −ln(T) = α_eff L, dimensionless. Collected Gaussian power transmission; alpha_eff = -ln(T) / L.

metrics.label: Peak probe saturation
metrics.help: Strongest-transition on-axis resonant s₀ before propagation; Gaussian peak intensity 6.37 W/m². The selected line's ν and Γ set I_sat = πhcΓ/(3λ³). Hyperfine transitions use the AutoOD-style s_t = s₀·C_F²/C_F,max² scale and local intensity depletion.

metrics.label: Probe model scope
metrics.help: Rb (natural) D1 uses line-specific two-level scaling without a matching finite-power reference.

metrics.label: Transmission at resonance
metrics.help: Probe transmission at two-photon resonance (transparency).

metrics.label: Window FWHM
metrics.help: Width of the transparency feature.

metrics.label: Group index n_g
metrics.help: n_g = n + ω dn/dω at resonance (slow light when ≫ 1).

metrics.label: AT splitting
metrics.help: Separation of the two absorption maxima.

metrics.label: Expected ≈ Ω_c
metrics.help: Coupling Rabi frequency Ω_c/2π.

metrics.label: Max spectral slope
metrics.help: Largest static dT/dnu; used internally for electrometry tests.

metrics.label: IF discriminator
metrics.help: Finite-difference transmission discriminator at the selected IF offset; a static proxy for a lock-in/superhet readout.

metrics.label: IF optimum detuning
metrics.help: Probe detuning where the finite-IF discriminator is largest.

metrics.label: Prediction scope
metrics.help: The opacity and its scenario range are assumed; absolute sensitivity and sweep optima lack held-out validation.

metrics.label: Total sensitivity
metrics.help: Finite-IF weak-SIG OBE response divided into the total balanced-detector ASD (PSN + RIN + electronics). This is a conditional model prediction, not the paper's 12.5 value injected as an anchor.

metrics.label: PSN-limited sensitivity
metrics.help: Probe photon-shot-noise contribution only, using the declared detector QE, optical path, reference arm, RF dipole, and RMS/peak convention.

metrics.label: RF field from fitted Ω_RF
metrics.help: Absolute field converted from the RF Rabi parameter used in the full optical-spectrum model. For experimental data, fit Ω_RF to the spectrum before using this value.

metrics.label: RF AT splitting
metrics.help: Separation of the two tallest dressed peaks.

metrics.label: AT split field estimate
metrics.help: Ideal two-level sqrt(split²-detuning²) estimate. Optical line pulling and multilevel effects are not corrected; the full-spectrum fitted Ω_RF field is preferred.

metrics.label: AT center shift
metrics.help: Height-weighted centre of the dressed transparency peaks; nonzero when the microwave is detuned off the 40D–39F resonance.

metrics.label: Technical field noise

metrics.label: Superhet optimum detuning
metrics.help: Probe detuning minimizing total noise-equivalent field, including transmission-dependent shot noise (full probe-detuning scan).

metrics.label: Superhet response phase
metrics.help: Photocurrent phasor phase relative to exp(-i omega_IF t).

metrics.label: RMS noise in ENBW
metrics.help: Total white-noise ASD integrated over 1 Hz ENBW.

metrics.label: Detector shot-current ASD

metrics.label: Squeezing [dB]
metrics.help: 10 log10(NF) from an effective Jasperse distributed gain/loss model with both vacuum reservoirs. The two gains and assumed common cell loss set the effective parameters. This experimental approximation is separate from microscopic atomic-noise theory.

metrics.label: Seed gain G_s
metrics.help: Qualitative model estimate; quantitative gain claim unsupported. Probe power at the atomic-medium exit / seed power at its entrance. The retired empirical gain correction is disabled in current runs.

metrics.label: Conjugate gain G_c
metrics.help: Qualitative model estimate; quantitative gain claim unsupported. Generated conjugate power gain at the selected detuning.
